item.title: Trump Says He Wants to Delay Visit to China Because of Middle East Conflict
item.summary: “I think it’s important that I be here,” President Trump said of asking China to reschedule a summit. Earlier, he disparaged allies for failing to embrace his request for help to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: In Iraq, the U.S. Tried to Bring Allies on Board. Not in Iran.
item.summary: This time, President Trump went to war without preparing the public, seeking U.N. approval or even consulting allies. But they will have to pick up the pieces.

item.title: As Rockets Fly Overhead, Residents of Israel’s Border City Stay Underground
item.summary: The Israeli government evacuated Kiryat Shmona during the last round of fighting with Hezbollah in 2023. Residents who were told it was safe to return are again under fire.

item.title: What the Iran War Means for the U.S.-China Relationship
item.summary: With the Xi-Trump summit now almost certainly delayed, and tensions rising over the war in Iran, vital issues for both the U.S. and China are also being cast into uncertainty.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Monday
item.summary: President Trump said he might postpone a trip to China to focus on the war. More than a million people have been displaced in Lebanon this month, according to the country’s health ministry.

item.title: As American Bombers Take Off From R.A.F. Fairford in UK, Iraq War Looms Large
item.summary: R.A.F. Fairford was the site of repeated antiwar protests during the Iraq war in 2003. Now it is being used again as a base for U.S. bombing missions in the Middle East.

item.title: How the Makers of ‘Mr. Nobody Against Putin’ Addressed ‘an Ethical Minefield’
item.summary: The documentary about Vladimir V. Putin’s wartime indoctrination of Russian schoolchildren won an Oscar at Sunday’s Academy Awards.

item.title: Pakistani-Afghan War Takes Heavy Toll on Civilians
item.summary: Pakistani airstrikes have killed at least 75 civilians and displaced 115,000 in Afghanistan, with both sides vowing escalation and no talks in sight.

item.title: 4 Palestinians Killed When Israeli Forces Open Fire on West Bank Family
item.summary: Six members of a Palestinian family went out for a ride in the car. Only two made it back home.

item.title: A Predictable Problem
item.summary: Iran’s closure of the Strait of Hormuz, a well-known problem, appears to have caught Trump off guard.
